title: PhysicsLimitAPI
summary: Per-axis limit of a D6 joint (a prim typed exactly PhysicsJoint), applied as PhysicsLimitAPI:<inst>. Read only on the D6: the typed joints carry their limits in their own columns. Presence of an instance makes the axis limited (or locked when low > high); absence of the instance leaves the axis free.
producer_scope: Both declared attributes of every applied instance are published at their resolved values (-inf and inf when unauthored). No rewrite.

columns.name: limit:<inst>:physics:low

verify.notes: transX/Y/Z: getLinearLimit(axis).lower; rotX: getTwistLimit().lower; rotY/rotZ: getPyramidSwingLimit().yAngleMin/zAngleMin. distance: no PhysX counterpart (the runtime only warns when low > 0), the helper returns NaN and the check is skipped. Absent columns leave the axis free and PhysX keeps its own default, so the absent value is not observable.

columns.absent: No lower bound. With the instance applied and both bounds absent the consumer seeds the schema fallbacks -inf/inf and leaves the axis free, as on a USD-populated stage.
columns.sentinel: -inf, or any value <= -0.5e38, means no lower bound; both bounds sentinel leaves the axis FREE. low > high locks the axis.
columns.units: rot axes: deg; trans axes and distance: length
columns.notes: conversion deg_to_rad applies to rotX/rotY/rotZ only; transX/transY/transZ and distance are stored unconverted.

columns.name: limit:<inst>:physics:high

verify.notes: transX/Y/Z: getLinearLimit(axis).upper; rotX: getTwistLimit().upper; rotY/rotZ: getPyramidSwingLimit().yAngleMax/zAngleMax; distance: getDistanceLimit().value. Not observable when absent; see low.

columns.absent: No upper bound. The consumer seeds the schema fallback inf; see low.
columns.sentinel: inf, or any value >= 0.5e38, means no upper bound.
columns.units: rot axes: deg; trans axes and distance: length
columns.notes: conversion deg_to_rad applies to rotX/rotY/rotZ only.

interactions.rule: Only a prim typed exactly PhysicsJoint reads these instances; the gate is usd-schemas CONTAINS PhysicsLimitAPI:<inst> per instance. Instance order in the descriptor follows the fixed list transX, transY, transZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ, distance.
PhysxLimitAPI:<same inst> supplies restitution, bounceThreshold, stiffness and damping for the limit created here.

notes: Per-joint-type instance matrix: Fixed none; Revolute none (uses physics:lowerLimit/upperLimit); Prismatic none (same); Spherical none (uses physics:coneAngle0Limit/coneAngle1Limit); Distance none (uses physics:minDistance/maxDistance); D6 (PhysicsJoint) transX transY transZ rotX rotY rotZ distance; Gear, Rack, Custom none.

Standalone D6 mapping: transX/Y/Z -> PxD6Axis::eX/eY/eZ linear limit (an open -inf/inf bound of a one-sided limit is clamped to the PhysX unlimited default +-PX_MAX_F32/3, so the authored bound still applies); rotX -> eTWIST twist limit; rotY/rotZ -> eSWING1/eSWING2 through one shared PxJointLimitPyramid (its y-angle bounds from rotY, its z-angle bounds from rotZ; the pyramid's restitution, bounceThreshold, stiffness and damping come from whichever of the two instances was processed last; every pyramid angle is clamped just inside +-pi, so a one-sided swing limit keeps its authored bound and its open -inf/inf bound becomes ~+-pi); distance -> the D6 distance limit at the high bound, and every still-free linear axis becomes eLIMITED. A minimum distance on a D6 is not supported (warning).

Articulation D6 joints ignore the translational and distance entries; only rotX/rotY/rotZ exist, as eTWIST/eSWING1/eSWING2 of an eSPHERICAL joint: an enabled limit makes the axis eLIMITED with both bounds clamped to +-pi, so a one-sided limit keeps its authored bound.
